methodology: Each relevant_scheme_ids entry was manually selected from the canonical dataset by reviewing scheme names and source eligibility/details. Labels were not generated from the RAG pipeline, FAISS rankings, or embedding model. This is a small, single-label benchmark intended for repeatable diagnostic evaluation, not a claim of comprehensive relevance coverage.
